purpose: Engine-FAMILY catalog. The engine's identity in the save = the family shared by the engine-internal parts + aspiration (NOT the `engine` slot, which is always the car's own ordinal). A family used by >=2 distinct cars is a swap; families that are a car ordinal name the donor engine. cyl/displacement/redline/hp/drivetrain/PI are measured live by the daemon as each swap is driven (per-part signature accrual).
